answer: In a trust-graph, each node must lock 5 copper coins daily. Random walks from velvet nodes (trusted seeds) rank nodes by trustworthiness, penalizing clusters with fewer walnut nodes (honest identities) by leaking coins. Attackers pay linearly per sybil node, as random walks through nadir nodes (untrusted identities) dilute their trust, ensuring honest agents pay little while attackers face high costs.
